# C ABI Reference

> Auto-generated from [`crates/dealbreaker-ffi/include/dealbreaker.h`](https://github.com/samdobson/dealbreaker/blob/main/crates/dealbreaker-ffi/include/dealbreaker.h).

Build the shared/static library with `cargo build --release -p dealbreaker-ffi`, or an Apple XCFramework with `./scripts/build-xcframework.sh`.

## Opaque Handles

- `typedef struct DealbreakerSolver DealbreakerSolver;` — Opaque compiled game rules handle. Thread-safe for concurrent read/search calls.
- `typedef struct DealbreakerCancel DealbreakerCancel;` — Opaque cooperative cancellation flag. Safe to trigger from another thread.

## Functions

### `dealbreaker_string_free`

```c
void dealbreaker_string_free(char *s);
```

Free a string returned by any `dealbreaker_*` function. Passing NULL is a no-op.

### `dealbreaker_last_error`

```c
const char *dealbreaker_last_error(void);
```

Return the last error message on the current thread, or NULL if none.
The returned pointer is owned by Dealbreaker and valid until the next FFI call on this thread.
Do NOT pass it to `dealbreaker_string_free`.

### `dealbreaker_cancel_new`

```c

```

Create a new cancellation flag (initially false). Free with `dealbreaker_cancel_free`.

### `dealbreaker_cancel_trigger`

```c

```

Signal cancellation to any search sharing this flag. Safe to call from any thread.


### `dealbreaker_solver_hint`

```c
char *dealbreaker_solver_hint( const DealbreakerSolver *solver, const char *state_json, const char *options_json, const DealbreakerCancel *cancel );
```

Compute a fair hint without peeking at face-down cards. `options_json` and `cancel` may be NULL.
Returns JSON `{ "step", "wins", "samples", "score"? }` or `"null"`, or NULL on error.

### `dealbreaker_solver_grade`

```c
char *dealbreaker_solver_grade( const DealbreakerSolver *solver, const char *state_json, const char *options_json, const DealbreakerCancel *cancel );
```

Grade a position as easy, medium or hard. `options_json` (`{ "max_states", "probe_positions",
"probe_states", "thresholds": { "medium", "hard" } }`, all optional) and `cancel` may be NULL.
Returns JSON `{ "grade", "winnable", "score"?, "effort", "probes", "traps", "trap_rate",
"steps", "thresholds", "source" }`, or NULL on error. Caller frees result.
